completeness.why: All five provider link handlers keep only their bank lookup and pass their own data to linkBankSyncAccount, which takes the upgrade-or-insert, transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event; the Pluggy file id, GoCardless mask/official name and Akahu's tables are explicit arguments, and the unreachable EnableBanking id check is dropped.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations (newAccountFields, fileId, syncedTables) and make the preserved inconsistencies explicit; syncedTables as a free string[] repeated by every caller is slightly looser than a named default would be.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies are removed and replaced by calls to one function; nothing is reshaped and kept.
